title: Hunter Radar
description:
Flagship product of TriPoint Innovations, LLC, developed through the Riata Startup Experience at Oklahoma State University and backed by a $75,000 USDA grant
LoRa wireless technology with ESP32, GPS, and BLE for offline and online geolocation
AI integrated tracking, boundary alerts, SOS signaling, and waypoint navigation for areas without cellular coverage
3.5-mile LoRa range and 12+ hour battery life across 2 field trials, with 3 prototype versions, 4 tracking nodes, and 3 enclosure iterations
Business model focused on outdoor safety, group coordination, and remote communication for hunters, landowners, and outdoor enthusiasts

title: GE Aerospace Turbine Manufacturing Engineering
tagline: Turbine hardware processing and quality improvement
description:
Supported turbine hardware processing and quality improvement for military and commercial propulsion programs
Created and tested 18+ VGT inspection tooling concepts for dimensional checks on features with tolerances up to 0.0006 in.
Led Stage 1 nozzle flow investigation analyzing TBC thickness, EDM cutback, geometry, and flow performance
Identified 3 hardware failure modes and created 5 process improvements for flight-critical turbine hardware

title: 6.7L Cummins Cost Reduction Engineering
description:
Led teardown and inspection of one 6.7L Cummins engine and four additional engines for remanufacturing
Conducted 40 hours of engine testing comparing aftermarket components against OEM standards
Analyzed manufacturing processes and documented failure modes, test results, and recommendations
Identified potential to reduce per-unit costs by approximately 30% while maintaining quality standards

title: OSU Homecoming Engineering Build
description:
Led an 8-person engineering team and 30+ laborers building a 60 ft x 18 ft x 12 ft automated display
Built integrated system with electrical control hardware, proximity sensors, and 8+ motors and actuators across 6 moving linkages
Developed relay and control logic for state detection, timing, and event sequencing
Modeled moving components with CAD, motion studies, and FEA, finding failure causes in 3 metal components and preventing $4,500 in rework
Placed 1st of 12 in front of 200,000+ people at OSU Homecoming
